framing-fall-protection-residential.note: OSHA guidance document, stage-by-stage residential framing fall protection (trusses, rafters, sheathing, walls, joists)

roof-truss-installation-and-bracing.note: OSHA Fact Sheet FS-3477; truss restraint/bracing, spreaders, ground assembly, anchors

wall-panel-raising-framing-hazards.note: OSHA SHIB 11-17-2005; wall raising collapse, limited access zone, wall jacks, cranes/forklifts. Advisory bulletin, aimed at employers but jobsite-practical

steel-erection-fall-protection-connector.note: OSHA eTool page; 15/30 ft rules, connectors, controlled decking zone, case reports

steel-erection-hoisting-and-rigging.note: OSHA eTool page; crane inspection, working under loads, multiple-lift rigging, case reports

steel-erection-bolting-and-decking-hazar.note: OSHA eTool page; structural stability, wrench-tight bolting, metal decking bundles/holes/installation, anchor rods, joists. Long page (about 31 KB); structurer may split

concrete-masonry-wall-bracing.note: OSHA Construction Resource Manual Q&A; masonry limited access zone and wall bracing (Q3/Q4). Same page also covers rebar impalement (Q2) and formwork drawings tip, so it is the only source used for that topic and is not reused for rebar

rebar-impalement-protection.note: Only worker-facing agency page found is the Subpart Q overview (already used for concrete-masonry-wall-bracing; can be re-assigned to rebar instead if preferred). Other hits are OSHA interpretation letters or regulation text.

formwork-and-shoring-safety.note: Only 29 CFR 1926.703 regulation text and interpretation letters on osha.gov; CPWR formwork item is a research key-findings card (not worker-facing); NY FACE formwork collapse report on stacks.cdc.gov could not be retrieved (access denied to scripted fetch).

concrete-pump-placement-safety.note: No agency toolbox talk or fact sheet found; only OSHA interpretation letters (2010, 2013) and a 1987 NIOSH FACE electrocution report (stacks.cdc.gov, not retrievable). Good talks exist only on ACPA/commercial sites, which are disallowed.
